text:
As of 2020, Sub-Saharan Africa had roughly 1.1 billion people, was the world's fastest-growing region with a median age around 18–19, and remained the poorest region by GDP per capita, with heavy dependence on agriculture and commodities. The claim that Congo's real income per person in 2020 was clearly below its 1980 level is not a fact I can confirm—Congo's trajectory is contested and depends on which country and data series are meant—so it should not be treated as the anchor for the region's growth record.  
CONFIDENCE: 60
